notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.2 - Localization and a new trap
notes.content:
Howdy Adventurers! 🤠

Hope everyone is having a great time slicing gems and enemies in Kingdom Run VR. Our second update focuses on localization and adding a new trap 🙌 

[b]Localization [/b]
Kingdom Run VR has been translated into Spanish, German, Italian and French! 

[b]Side Axe Traps[/b]
More traps in Endless? You are damn right! Side axes can now be found throughout the endless tombs of Kingdom Run VR 👀 These brutal axes line the stretch of the tomb 🏃 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43370970/8e411178bd40892771251d4697a334228c8ceb6d.png[/img]

[b]Quality of life changes[/b]
We have gone through and made changes. The main focus was the organisation of nearly all the UI to be more clean and support localization along with minor fixes like adding the leaderboard to the office 🙌 

A list of all changes in update 1.2 can be found below!

Slice dem gems,
Alarming Ladder

Additions:
[list]
[*] Side Axe traps in Endless
[*] Localization for Spanish
[*] Localization for German
[*] Localization for Italian
[*] Localization for French
[*] Localization Menu
[*] Global scoreboard in the Main Menu
[*] Image of our bounty winner
[/list]

Quality of life changes:
[list]
[*] UI changes for new wording
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Leaderboards, Index Support and Changes
notes.content:
Howdy Adventurers! 🤠

Hope everyone is having a great time slicing gems and enemies in Kingdom Run VR. Our first update focuses on fixing issues that have appeared along with adding highly requested content 🙌 

[b]Leaderboard[/b]
You want to prove you are the best? Now is your chance! Get the furthest distance possible and claim the top 3 spots on the Kingdom Run VR and have your name etched in glory 🏆 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43370970/a86e19e484b6b8a2675ab3fffb98b26493e06264.png[/img]

[b]Index Support[/b]
Valve Index users can now play Kingdom Run VR 🤩 So you have no excuse to get on that leaderboard and collect them gems 💎

[b]Blade Traps[/b]
So you thought you mastered all the traps in Endless? Think again! Blade traps can now be found throughout the endless tombs of Kingdom Run VR 👀  These large blades are found in tight formations and require speedy side-to-side movement 🏃 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43370970/b151a5d943a0e301d1dde6347e21e6595542c0e6.png[/img]

A list of all changes in update 1.1 can be found below!

Slice dem gems,
Alarming Ladder

Additions:
[list]
[*] Blade tiles in Endless
[*] Personal scoreboard in the Endless spawn area
[*] Global scoreboard with a top 3 system
[*] Valve Index support
[/list]

Quality of life changes:
[list]
[*] Hearts UI now stays with you i.e., lowers when crouching
[*] Lighting changes to enclosing walls and falling roof tiles in Endless
[*] Office in the Main Menu assets rearranged 
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Text changes on scoreboards so it will no longer overlap text
[*] Windows in office have a new material
[*] Missing logo when VR is not connected 
[*] High distance should now stay after closing the application 
[/list]
